rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The plan rate is carried as an amount (5% as $0.05) so that Pub. 560's rate for the self-employed, rate / (1 + rate) (chapter 5, Rate Table for Self-Employed), is figured exactly; the model wrote the percentage as a number. The lines that use it agree: Deduction Worksheet for Self-Employed step 6 ($17,500.00) and steps 5, 7 and 21, the SEP deduction and Schedule 1 line 16 (all $0.00, no Schedule C).

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The project counts each employer entered on the tip roster ('List stable keys for each employer from which you received tips'), the model only those with an amount above zero. An entry of $0 changes no amount: line 4c totals the worksheet's column (d), and with two or more employers line 4a is $0 either way (i1040gi p. 104).
